question: Does the Rs 2000 banknote still remain legal tender after its withdrawal from circulation?
expected_answer: Yes. The Rs 2000 banknote continues to maintain its legal tender status.

question: At how many RBI offices can Rs 2000 banknotes be exchanged?
expected_answer: At the 19 Regional Offices of RBI having Issue Departments (RBI Issue Offices).

question: Is any interest paid on the balance kept in an e-Rupee (Digital Rupee) wallet?
expected_answer: No. Because e-Rupee has cash-like features, no interest is paid on wallet balances.

question: What is the offline feature of e-Rupee?
expected_answer: It lets users transact in places with limited or no internet connectivity, like physical cash, which helps in remote areas; different solutions are being explored.

question: How many banks offer e-Rupee wallets, and what is the name of Axis Bank's e-Rupee app?
expected_answer: 19 banks offer CBDC wallets; Axis Bank's app is 'Axis Mobile Digital Rupee'.

question: What is the name of Kotak Mahindra Bank's e-Rupee app?
expected_answer: Digital Rupee by Kotak Bank (also available in the Kotak Bank mobile banking app).

question: What does the Indian Rupee symbol Rs look like?
expected_answer: It resembles both the Devanagari letter 'ra' and the Latin capital letter 'R', with a double horizontal line at the top.

question: What is a 'star series' banknote?
expected_answer: A banknote used to replace a defectively printed note in a packet of 100 serially numbered notes; it is like other notes but has a * (star) in the number panel between the prefix and the number.

question: When was the Rs 10 banknote of the Mahatma Gandhi Series 1996 introduced?
expected_answer: June 1996.

question: When was the Rs 20 banknote of the Mahatma Gandhi Series 2005 introduced?
expected_answer: August 2006.

question: What was the limit for exchanging specified bank notes (old Rs 500/Rs 1000) for NRIs at RBI offices?
expected_answer: Rs 25,000 per NRI (facility from January 2, 2017 to June 30, 2017 at five RBI offices).
file_name: Withdrawal of Legal Tender Character of the Old Bank Notes in the denominations.pdf

question: What is the penalty for holding specified bank notes (old Rs 500/Rs 1000) beyond the permitted limit?
expected_answer: A fine up to Rs 10,000 or five times the face value of the notes involved, whichever is higher (Section 7).
file_name: Withdrawal of Legal Tender Character of the Old Bank Notes in the denominations.pdf

question: Can an NRI be made a nominee for the 7.75% Savings (Taxable) Bonds, 2018?
expected_answer: No. The nomination facility for NRIs is not available for the 7.75% Savings (Taxable) Bonds, 2018 scheme (it is allowed for 8% Savings (Taxable) Bonds, 2003).
file_name: Master Directions on Relief Savings Bonds.pdf

question: Within how many days must a Regulated Entity comply with an RBI Ombudsman Award?
expected_answer: Within 30 days from receipt of the complainant's letter of acceptance (or appeal to the Appellate Authority within that time, where permitted).

question: Which categories of complainant can be ticked on the RBI Ombudsman complaint form?
expected_answer: Individual, Person with Disabilities, Senior Citizen, Individual - Business, Proprietorship, Partnership, MSME, Association, Trust, Limited Company, Government Department, PSU.
file_name: ComplaintForm_English(FORM OF COMPLAINT (TO BE LODGED) WITH THE RBI OMBUDSMAN).pdf

question: How does a SIM swap or SIM cloning fraud work?
expected_answer: Fraudsters gain access to the customer's SIM card or obtain a duplicate SIM (including e-SIM) for the mobile number registered with the bank account, and use it to receive OTPs and make unauthorised transactions.

question: What should you do after a screen sharing app is no longer needed?
expected_answer: Remove the screen sharing app from your device as soon as the work is completed; download such apps only when advised through the company's official toll-free number.

question: What were India's foreign exchange reserves as on May 29, 2026?
expected_answer: US$ 682.3 billion.

question: To what levels did the GNPA and NNPA ratios of scheduled commercial banks fall?
expected_answer: Multi-decadal lows of 2.3 per cent (GNPA) and 0.5 per cent (NNPA).
file_name: Chapter II Financial Institutions Soundness and Resilience.pdf
notes: Para 2.5, Asset quality; page 12 repeats the 2.3 per cent GNPA figure (review L3)

question: What is the due date for participating in the Coordinated Portfolio Investment Survey (CPIS)?
expected_answer: July 15 for the end-March position and December 31 for the end-September position.

question: Since when has India participated in the CPIS, and when did it move to semi-annual reporting?
expected_answer: India has participated in the IMF's annual CPIS since 2004 and moved to semi-annual reporting in 2014.

question: To which email address should mutual fund companies send the FLA survey schedule?
expected_answer: mf@rbi.org.in (Schedule-4 in .xls format, with no other attachments).

question: How often is the Foreign Collaboration Survey (FCS) conducted and what is its due date?
expected_answer: Biennially; responses must be submitted on or before July 15 of the survey year (the survey is launched in June).

question: In which format must companies fill the Annual Survey on Computer Software & ITES Exports?
expected_answer: In Excel format (.xls), available on the RBI website.

question: How often must Regional Rural Banks carry out periodic updation of KYC for high, medium and low risk customers?
expected_answer: At least once every 2 years for high-risk, every 8 years for medium-risk and every 10 years for low-risk customers.

question: Must a customer keep a minimum balance in a BSBD account at a Local Area Bank?
expected_answer: No. A Local Area Bank must offer the basic BSBD facilities free of charge without any minimum balance requirement.
notes: LAB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, BSBD account

question: What minimum capital must a commercial bank maintain under the Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy?
expected_answer: Minimum Total Capital (CRAR) of 9 per cent of RWAs, with CET1 capital of at least 5.5 per cent of RWAs.
file_name: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital.pdf
notes: Para 11 (p.14); the 9 per cent CRAR is also stated on p.13; page 60 repeats CET1 5.5 per cent (review L3)

question: From when do the Commercial Banks - Forthcoming Instructions Amendment Directions, 2026 on counterparty credit risk apply, and to which banks?
expected_answer: From April 1, 2027, to commercial banks with an international presence or with derivatives outstanding (book value) of Rs 25,000 crore and above; other banks may choose CEM or SA-CCR.

question: From when does the revised Basel III capital framework apply to commercial banks, and which banks are excluded?
expected_answer: From April 01, 2027; Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks and Regional Rural Banks are excluded.

question: Under the DRI scheme, how much finance can banks give and at what interest rate?
expected_answer: Up to Rs 15,000 at a concessional interest rate of 4 per cent per annum; SC/ST borrowers should get at least 2/5th (40 per cent) of total DRI advances.
file_name: Appendix Credit Facilities to Scheduled Castes Scheduled Tribes List of.pdf

question: Under the Payments Banks Internal Ombudsman Directions, how many banking outlets must a Payments Bank have for the rules to apply, and from when does a bank that qualifies later have to follow them?
expected_answer: Payments Banks with 10 or more banking outlets in India as on March 31, 2025. A Payments Bank that meets this after March 31, 2025 must follow the directions six months after meeting the criteria.
notes: near-identical to the SFB / Commercial Bank / CIC directions: the right FILE must win

question: For the Commercial Banks Internal Ombudsman Directions, which kinds of banks are NOT counted as 'Commercial Banks'?
expected_answer: Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks and Local Area Banks are excluded; a bank in resolution, winding up or under directions is also not included.

question: Under the withdrawn 2017 circular on limiting customer liability, how much is a customer liable for if an unauthorised electronic transaction is reported on the 5th working day?
expected_answer: Within 4 to 7 working days: the transaction value or the amount in Table 1, whichever is lower. (Within 3 working days = zero liability; beyond 7 days = as per the bank's Board approved policy.)

question: Under the withdrawn customer protection circular, within how many working days must a bank credit back (shadow reversal) the amount of an unauthorised electronic transaction?
expected_answer: Within 10 working days from the date the customer notifies the bank.

question: In the withdrawn Master Circular on exposure norms for urban co-operative banks, what is the maximum exposure to a single borrower and to a group of connected borrowers?

expected_answer: Half-yearly.

question: Which three groups of regulated entities got the revised Master Directions on Fraud Risk Management in July 2024?
expected_answer: (i) Commercial Banks (including RRBs) and All India Financial Institutions; (ii) Co-operative Banks (UCBs / StCBs / CCBs); (iii) NBFCs (including Housing Finance Companies).
